name: Bassline
description: Club-dark site for a music producer selling beats, leases and mixing, with a beat-synced equaliser and glowing beat cards.
features: Full-width equaliser and drum pads pulsing to a simulated 124 BPM beat, with play/pause
Six beat cards with BPM/key tags, lease prices, glow on hover and visual previews
Service grid, licence tiers, studio credits and a four-step mixing process
Artist testimonials, FAQ and a booking form with a service selector
signature: Equaliser bars and drum pads pulse to a fake 124 BPM beat with a play/pause toggle (no audio); beat cards glow on hover
